quizzes.title: Neural Networks & Backpropagation Quiz
quizzes.description: Evaluates understanding of activation functions, loss gradients, and pooling operations.

quizzes.title: React Server Components & Hooks Quiz
quizzes.description: Evaluates useEffect, useMemo, custom hooks, and server components.

quiz_questions.question_text: Which activation function is most commonly used in hidden layers of Deep Neural Networks to prevent vanishing gradients?
quiz_questions.explanation: ReLU outputs zero for negative inputs and identity for positive inputs, preventing derivative saturation.

quiz_questions.question_text: What is the primary role of the Backpropagation algorithm?
quiz_questions.explanation: Backpropagation applies the chain rule backward from loss to compute gradients for parameter updates.

quiz_questions.question_text: In Convolutional Neural Networks, what does a Max Pooling layer do?
quiz_questions.explanation: Max pooling takes the maximum value in a window grid, downsampling features while preserving translation invariance.

quiz_options.option_text: To compute loss directly without gradients
To update network weights by calculating loss gradients via the chain rule
To compress input images into lower dimensions
Increases spatial resolution of feature maps
Reduces spatial dimensions while preserving dominant features
Adds bias parameters to zero padding
Applies a linear transformation across channels
